signals.title: Another reason to commute by motorcycle? This UK parking tax doesn't apply to PTWs
signals.summary: Motorcycles are exempt from the UK's Workplace Parking Levy, meaning riders avoid a commuter charge affecting workplace car parking. Here's what every biker should know. As the cost of getting to work continues to rise, from higher insurance premiums and fuel prices to increasingly expensive parking, there's one charge that motorcycle riders can largely ignore. The Workplace Parking Levy (WPL), a scheme designed to reduce congestion and encourage alternative forms of transport, which is backed by the new PM, Andy Burnham, does not apply to motorcycles. The levy isn't a new idea. Introduced in Nottingham in 2012, it charges employers for providing workplace parking spaces, with the aim of encouraging commuters to consider alternatives to driving alone. While businesses decide whether to absorb the cost or pass it on to employees, the result is the same: parking at work can become significantly more expensive for those arriving by car. Motorcycles, however, are treated differently. Under Nottingham's Workplace Parking Levy scheme, motorcycle parking spaces are exempt from the charge and are not counted as liable workplace parking places. The reasoning is fairly straightforward, in that motorcycles occupy considerably less space than cars, contribute less to congestion, and make more efficient use of limited parking capacity. signals.title: Ducati takeover bidder's CEO takes to social media to back sale claims
signals.summary: Ducati's sale rumours have taken another twist, with an Italian investment company confirming the news, while the firm's CEO publicly backed the claim on social media. For more than a year, rumours that Ducati could be sold by Volkswagen Group have come and gone, fuelled by reports of wider restructuring within the German automotive giant rather than anything direct from the Borgo Panigale. Now, for the first time, a company has publicly confirmed it has made an offer to buy the Italian manufacturer. Speaking to RideApart, Massimo Ros, founder of Italian investment company Patritalia S.p.A., said his company had formally approached Volkswagen with a bid to acquire Ducati Motor Holding in its entirety. "I can confirm that the rumours are well founded. Patritalia S.p.A has formally expressed its interest and is fully prepared to acquire 100% of Ducati Motor Holding S.p.A." According to Ros, Patritalia was founded with the aim of returning iconic Italian companies to Italian ownership. "The sole mission I set behind the creation of Patritalia is to 'bring back home' our Italian companies and iconic Italian brands that are currently under foreign ownership and bring them back under Italian control. Our objective is to promote a form of industrial repossession, allowing these historic brands to once again be guided by Italian vision, culture, creativity, with the goal of restoring the soul of the Italian entrepreneurial spirit." signals.title: Honda refreshes the colour palette for the NC750X twin-cylinder
signals.summary: For 2027, Honda is giving its mid-size crossover a fresh aesthetic look: the Japanese manufacturer leaves the mechanics untouched while expanding the range of available colors. The 2027 NC750X will be available in four distinct shades: the brand-new Glint Wave Blue Metallic joins the updated Mat Deep Mud Gray and Earth Black , alongside the returning Earth Khaki . The latter models feature fairing parts crafted from Durabio , a biomass-derived polycarbonate resin. The practical 23-liter front utility compartment —located where the fuel tank usually sits and easily capable of swallowing a full-face helmet—remains a standout feature. Mechanically, everything stays true to the previous generation: the proven 745 cc parallel twin powers the bike, fully compliant with Euro5+ regulations . It features Throttle By Wire electronic acceleration, 5 Riding Modes (3 presets, 2 custom), and multi-level HSTC traction control . The engine pumps out 58.6 horsepower at 6,750 rpm and 69 Nm of peak torque at 4,750 rpm, with a 35 kW restricted variant also available for A2 license holders. Riders can still choose between a traditional six-speed manual gearbox and Honda’s innovative Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT) . Suspension duties are handled by a 41 mm Showa SDBV telescopic fork and a Pro-Link rear monoshock, both offering 120 mm of travel. signals.title: Held summer motorcycle gloves: comfort and technology for riding
signals.summary: As a historic company with eighty years of excellence and innovation in motorcycle gear, Held combines ergonomics, safety, and meticulous craftsmanship into three new summer gloves designed to offer optimal riding feel and ventilation. The Tactura model focuses on lightness and complete freedom of movement thanks to its Spandex and mesh back, paired with a Chamude palm featuring silicone for a secure grip, backed by EN 13594:2015 certification. Stepping up, the Hamada 2 balances advanced protection with precision control by combining goatskin and Nypsan, integrating D3O knuckle protectors, SuperFabric inserts, NUDUD smartphone-friendly technology, and ACS ventilation. Finally, rounding out the lineup is the Sambia KTC 2 , a premium product for summer touring. This model combines an extremely durable kangaroo leather palm, a highly perforated back with a knitted wrist cover, NUDUD touchscreen technology, and advanced protections, including an injected knuckle cover and Armaprotec reinforcements. Bahkan, sebelum pemesanan resmi dibuka, jumlah pesanan yang masuk secara manual disebut sudah melampaui kuota awal yang disiapkan PT Honda Prospect Motor (HPM). Sales & Marketing Director PT Honda Prospect Motor, Yusak Billy, mengatakan, saat ini pemesanan Honda Super One telah melebihi 100 unit. Baca juga: Impresi Perdana Toyota Hilux Terbaru, Beda Karakter Manual dan Matic Padahal, Honda hanya mendapatkan alokasi sebanyak 100 unit untuk pasar Indonesia pada 2026. "Secara manual (pemesanan) sudah melebihi 100 unit. Tapi kita akan memonitor aktual sekarang setelah dibuka secara resmi jadi berapa (pemesanan). Jadi yang pesan secara manual itu sudah lebih dari kuota," kata Billy di ICE BSD City, Tangerang, Rabu (5/8/2026). PT Honda Prospect Motor mulai membuka pemesanan Honda Super One secara resmi pada Rabu (5/8/2026). Sebelumnya, mobil listrik tersebut lebih dulu diperkenalkan kepada publik saat pembukaan Gaikindo Indonesia International Auto Show (GIIAS) 2026 pada 30 Juli lalu. signals.title: Tanggapan Transjakarta Soal Lansia yang Diusir dari Bus
signals.summary: Tanggapan Transjakarta Soal Lansia yang Diusir dari Bus TANGERANG, KOMPAS.com - Beberapa hari ini viral video seorang lansia diturunkan petugas dari bus TransJakarta di Halte Kampung Melayu, Jakarta Timur. Pada narasi dalam video yang beredar menyebutkan lansia itu diturunkan lantaran bau badan. Namun, pihak Transjakarta menjelaskan lansia tersebut diturunkan karena aroma urine yang sangat kuat. Petugas bertindak setelah mendapat laporan dari penumpang lain. PT TransJakarta buka suara mengenai video viral yang menampilkan petugasnya menurunkan penumpang secara paksa dari bus bukan karena bau badan. Jadi mengganggu yang lain. Begitu diturunkan dengan cara persuasif, publik bergejolak," kata Welfizon Yuza, Direktur Utama Transjakarta di ICE BSD, Rabu (5/6/2026). Welfizon menceritakan, tindakan yang dilakukan oleh petugas menimbulkan berbagai tanggapan.
